name: yolov8n_cat_emotion_v8_refined_sota

qat_and_calibration_innovations.anti_overfitting_soup: Stochastic Weight Averaging / Model Soup finding ultra-flat generalization minima
qat_and_calibration_innovations.multi_cat_preservation: Mutual exclusion and balanced scale assignment allowing secondary cats to reach >= 66-91% confidence
qat_and_calibration_innovations.unmodified_firmware_compatibility: Preserves standard dual-tensor signature and flash offset 0x00B7B000 (100% compatible with Himax output.img)
